title: Accidental Damage Replacement of Northgate Optical Eyewear
content:
**Northgate Optical accidental damage replacement.** Eyewear damaged by accident is replaced only within the accidental damage coverage months of the lens design counted from the dispensed date, and no more often than the design's allowed number of accidental damage replacements; the member authorizes the replacement and its accidental replacement charge, which is booked as the remake charge of the replacement.

The replacement is a remake of the job for the reason accidental damage. Its charge is paid by the member.

## Conditions on fixing the charge

The accidental replacement charge is fixed only after the original base-lens charge carries the switch-down credit owed for any lower-priced lens design the job has been remade in.

The accidental replacement charge is not fixed until each prescription-change remake charge on the job, less any waiver posted against it, stands no higher than the late prescription-change remake charge it is owed at.

## The member's authorization: `authorize_damage_replacement_0a7f54ae`

**Capability.** With this tool the member authorizes the paid replacement of eyewear they damaged by accident and accepts its charge. One call opens the replacement on the member's eyewear job — the job goes to the lab as a remake and its remake count becomes the remake number given — and books the replacement charge, with the amount given and the reason accidental damage, dated today, to be paid by the member. The charge does not earn Annual Reward.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it for the member (`unlock_user_discoverable_tool`) and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it (`call_user_discoverable_tool`), with the values the member services representative reads or states to them.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `optical_order_id` | the reference number of the member's eyewear job being replaced, as the representative reads it to the member from the eyewear job lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the member's customer reference number, as the representative reads it from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `remake_number` | the number this replacement takes among the remakes of the job, as the representative states it | non-negative integer: 1 for the first remake, 2 for the second, and so on |
| `replacement_charge_usd` | the replacement charge the member authorizes, in USD, as the representative states it | plain number, no currency sign, 2 decimal places, not below 0; rounded half-to-even to 2 decimal places on booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `optical_txn_id` (the reference number of the replacement charge), `optical_order_id` (the job replaced), `remake_number` (the remake opened), `amount` (the charge authorized, USD with 2 decimal places), `remake_reason` (always `accidental_damage`), `job_status` (`remake_in_lab` once the replacement is with the lab) and `status` (`authorized` when the replacement and its charge are recorded).
